use.title: How you use NoCapOS
use.hint: The screen, your other devices, or both. The switches below follow along.
use.bothText: NoCap Desktop on this screen, plus NoCapOS in the browser on the rest of your devices at home.
use.desktopText: NoCap Desktop on this screen. Other devices can't open NoCapOS.
use.webText: No desktop on this machine. Run NoCapOS from your other devices' browsers.
use.failed: Couldn't switch how NoCapOS is used
